subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The central skateboard/skateboarder remains visually consistent after the first board-only close shot: dark clothing, white shoes, similar board, and same riding action persist across shots.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots stay in the same wooden skate bowl with blue coping/rail, concrete floor, trees above, and similar lighting. The painted wall appears later but fits the same skatepark.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Low concrete-level view and board motion are present, but the rider is mostly absent from frame.
Skateboarder carves up the bowl wall; tracking/side-view feel is plausible.
Still shows the skateboarder near the wall/lip, but it is not clearly overhead and no small ollie or landing is visible.
Behind-rider follow shot toward a painted wall with a leaning turn matches well.
Skateboarder crosses the bowl at speed, but the view is not clearly telephoto and motion streaking is limited.
Close view shows the rider controlling the board, but it is not clearly a front three-quarter rollout or steady exit.

which_cut_broke.how: No cut clearly breaks identity or scene consistency; the main issues are caption-adherence mismatches in shot 2 and mild view/action mismatches later.

cheat_flags.rationale: Shots show distinct views and evolving skateboard motion rather than copied or frozen frames.
